search_log: Listed every BioMarin (CIK 0001048477) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older pages): 352 8-K, 18 8-K/A, 83 10-Q, 27 10-K (all forms counted). Took every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2005-01 to 2026-11 whose items include 2.02, 9.01, 7.01 or 12 (or carry no item codes) and fetched every non-primary .htm exhibit via each filing's index.json; 10-Q/10-K primary documents fetched where a check needed them.

Each quarter is read from that quarter's own earnings release (filed in the month after quarter end), from the first table whose first cell starts with the brand; when two 8-Ks of one quarter carried the row, the earlier-filed release was used. Unit read from the table header or the nearest preceding unit statement: thousands in the releases filed 2006-02 and 2006-05, millions otherwise.

Release formats: 2005-2007 releases print the earlier year first (prior-year quarter, then current quarter), so value_reported is the second quoted figure for those rows; 2008-2011 releases lead with a one-column summary table ('Naglazyme Net Product Revenue | $x'); 2012 onwards current quarter first.

2008Q4 and 2009Q4: the fourth-quarter releases print Naglazyme only for the full year in their tables; the fourth-quarter figure is printed as current in the release's 'Net Product Revenue' paragraph ('... was $36.5 million for the fourth quarter of 2008'; '... was $44.4 million for the fourth quarter of 2009'), which those rows quote. 2010Q4 and 2011Q4 come from the Q4 release's quarter table (row 'Naglazyme (1)'), not its full-year summary.
Cross-checks: 2008Q4 36.5 = FY 2008 132.7 (10-K 2008) less nine months 96.2 (Q3 2008 10-Q); 2009Q4 44.4 equals the prior-year column of the Q4 2010 release.
